name: پرستار شیفت شب با چرخه خواب به‌هم‌ریخته
description: A Persian hospital nurse works night shifts with a broken sleep cycle, asks what to do to sleep during the day, and reports her body getting sick from the schedule. Verifies the sleep thread opens, the day-sleeping question is answered, and the health toll stays on the health thread.

turns.text: شیفت شب کار می‌کنم و چرخه خوابم به هم ریخته
از این برنامه بدنم مریض می‌شه

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the sleep thread (night shifts, broken cycle). Turn 2 answers the day-sleeping question in Persian. Turn 3 keeps the physical toll on the health thread.
expected.behavior: A shift-worker sleep complaint is handled as lived experience with a real answer to the practical day-sleeping question, and the health worry is met with care rather than a canned fallback.
